newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Cimpor sees 1996 profit over 23 bln esc.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Cimpor sees 1996 profit over 23 bln esc.

text.p: Portugal's state-controlled cement maker Cimpor, which is being privatised, said that full 1996 net profit would be "at least double" the 11.6 billion escudos posted in the first six months of the year.
The company made a consolidated net profit of 18.4 billion escudos in 1995.
"Cimpor's profit in 1996 will be at least double the six-month figure," company chairman Antonio Sousa Gomes told a news conference to present details of the privatisation.
Sousa Gomes said the profit growth reflected the positive evolution of the construction sector.
